class ConfigError(ContraagentError, ValueError)

class ContraagentDeprecationWarning(DeprecationWarning)

class ContraagentError(Exception)

class CredentialError(ContraagentError)

class DeferralCause(BaseModel)
    cause: str
    dependency: str | None = Field(default=None, description='`dependency_deferred`: the key of the deferred task whose output it reads')
    flow_call: str | None = Field(default=None, description="`deadline`, `grace_window`, `cannot_finish`: the flow call whose time box it is; null for the run's deadline")
    left_s: float | None = Field(default=None, description='`cannot_finish`: the time left before the deadline, in seconds')
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid', frozen=True)
    need_s: float | None = Field(default=None, description='`cannot_finish`: the work it needed, in seconds')
    rests: tuple[SkippedHop, ...] = Field(default=(), description='`rest`: each hop passed over and why its credential rests')
    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]

class Frame(BaseModel)
    file: str = Field(description="relative to the run's working directory when under it, else as recorded")
    function: str = Field(description='`module.qualname`')
    line: int
    loops: tuple[Loop, ...] = Field(default=(), description='the loops of a generator whose pass `line` was in, outermost first; empty outside a loop and for any other frame')
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid', frozen=True, serialize_by_alias=True)

class Hop(BaseModel)
    agent: str = ''
    cost_usd: float | None = None
    credential: str = ''
    model: str = ''
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='allow', frozen=True)
    other_models: dict[str, OtherModel] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    route: str = ''
    stop: str = ''
    usage: TokenUsage | None = None
    wall_s: float = 0.0

class LaunchError(ContraagentError)

class Loop(BaseModel)
    line: int = Field(description="the loop's first line, which names it")
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid', frozen=True, serialize_by_alias=True)
    pass_: int | None = Field(validation_alias=AliasChoices('pass', 'pass_'), serialization_alias='pass', description='one iteration of this loop, numbered from 1 since the loop was last entered in that frame; null when not counted')

    max_corrections: int | None = None

    tools: Sequence[str] | None = None,
    rerun_on_resume: bool = False,
    preserve: Sequence[str] = (),
    output_of: AgentTask[Any] | PythonTask[Any] | None = None,
    implementations: Mapping[str, str | Path] | None = None,
    outside_state: OutsideState | None = None,
    agent: str | None = None,
    model: str | None = None,
    effort: str | None = None,
    credential: str | None = None,
    model_failover: bool | None = None,
    fallbacks: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None,
    safety_stop_failover: Sequence[Literal['response', 'tool']] | None = None,
    disallowed_tools: Sequence[str] | None = None,
    max_turns: int | None = None,
    timeout_s: float | None = None,
    max_budget_usd: float | None = None,
    stall_s: float | None = None,
    context_budget: int | None = None,
    context_warn_pct: int | None = None,
    max_denials: int | None = None,
    max_concurrent: int | None = None,
    retries: int | None = None,
    retry_backoff_base: float | None = None,
    partial_on: Sequence[Literal['timeout', 'stalled']] | None = None,
    keep_failed_changes: bool | None = None,
    max_corrections: int | None = None,
) -> AgentTask[Out] | Mapping[str, AgentTask[Out]]

def import_recording(
    run_dir: str | Path,
    directory: str | Path,
    *,
    record_max_file_mb: float = MAX_FILE_MB,
) -> RecordingImport

def log(name: str, row: Mapping[str, Any] | BaseModel) -> None

def max_passes(n: int, /) -> Callable[[F], F]

def pipeline_table(name: str) -> dict[str, Any]

def python_task(fn: Callable[..., Out], /) -> PythonTask[Out]

def python_task(
    *,

    retries: int = 0,
    retry_on: tuple[type[Exception], ...] = (),
    output_name: str | None = None,
    outside_state: OutsideState | None = None,
) -> Callable[[Callable[..., Out]], PythonTask[Out]]

    fn: Callable[..., Any] | None = None,

    output_name: str | None = None,

) -> PythonTask[Any] | Callable[[Callable[..., Any]], PythonTask[Any]]

## contraagent.backends

class Backend(abc.ABC)
    def __init__(self, binary: str = '', base_env: dict[str, str] | None = None)
    def account(self, credential: Credential, model: str = '') -> str
    @abstractmethod
    def argv(self, launch: Launch) -> list[str]
    def attest(self, launch_result: LaunchResult, credential: Credential) -> str | None
    def base_path(self) -> str | None
    binary: str = ''
    def bind_credential(
        self,
        credential: Credential,
        model: str = '',
        *,
        env: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        label: str = '',
    ) -> CredentialBinding
    def catalogue(self) -> set[str] | None
    catalogue_timeout_s: float = 30.0
    def context_window(self, model: str) -> int | None
    cost_is_session_total: bool = False
    def discard_session(self, launch: Launch, session_id: str) -> None
    drivable_model_chain: bool = False
    effort_levels: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
    @abstractmethod
    def env(self, launch: Launch) -> dict[str, str]
    def exchange(
        self,
        launch: Launch,
        argv: list[str],
        env: dict[str, str],
        fold: EventFold,
        watch: LimitsWatch,
    ) -> tuple[bytes, str, int | None, Stop | None]
    def fold(self, launch: Launch) -> EventFold
    def launch_failed(
        self,
        launch: Launch,
        why: str,
        *,
        argv: list[str] | None = None,
        started_at: str = '',
        t0: float | None = None,
    ) -> LaunchResult
    light_launch: bool = False
    def mark_launch(self, launch: Launch) -> None
    def model_chains(self, cwd: Path | None = None) -> ModelChains | None
    def models(self) -> dict[str, int | None] | None
    name: str = ''
    native_model_chain: bool = False
    needs_inline_role_file: bool = False
    plaintext_stream: bool = False
    def prepare(self, launch: Launch) -> Launch
    def read_models(self) -> dict[str, int | None] | None
    def reclassify(self, launch_result: LaunchResult, stderr: str) -> None
    def resumable(self, launch: Launch) -> Launch
    def resumed(self, launch: Launch, prior: LaunchResult, prompt: str) -> Launch | None
    def run(self, launch: Launch) -> LaunchResult
    def run_catalogue(self, *args: str, env: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> str | None
    def scratch(self, label: str, which: str, create: bool = True) -> Path
    def scratch_parent(self) -> Path | None
    signals: Signals = Signals(stderr_stops=frozenset())
    stop_hooks_file: str | None = None
    @classmethod
    def tool_deny_problem(cls, denied: tuple[str, ...]) -> str | None
    def usage_reading(self, launch: Launch) -> QuotaReading | None
    def version(self) -> str
    def watch_stderr(self, launch: Launch) -> Sink | None
    watched_limits: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
    wire: ModuleType | None = None

class CallFile(BaseModel)
    cwd: str = ''
    key: str
    kind: str
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    output: CallOutput | None = None
    params: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    @staticmethod
    def path_of(launch: Launch) -> Path | None
    @classmethod
    def read(cls, path: Path) -> CallFile
    run: str
    unit: str = ''
    version: int = 1
    def write(self, path: Path) -> Path

class CallOutput(BaseModel)
    commands: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    format: Literal['json', 'text', 'jsonl'] = 'json'
    from_: Literal['file', 'message'] = Field('file', validation_alias=AliasChoices('from', 'from_'), serialization_alias='from')
    json_schema: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid', serialize_by_alias=True)
    path: str
    preserve: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    schema_ref: SchemaRef | None = None

class CallUsage

    cache_read: int
    @property context: int

    output: int

    def argv(self, launch: Launch) -> list[str]
    def attest(self, launch_result: LaunchResult, credential: Credential) -> str | None

        self,
        credential: Credential,

        label: str = '',
    ) -> CredentialBinding
    cost_is_session_total = True
    def discard_session(self, launch: Launch, session_id: str) -> None
    drivable_model_chain = True
    effort_levels: tuple[str, ...] | None = ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh', 'max')
    def env(self, launch: Launch) -> dict[str, str]
    def fold(self, launch: Launch) -> EventFold
    light_launch = True
    name = 'claude'
    native_model_chain = True
    def resumable(self, launch: Launch) -> Launch
    def resumed(self, launch: Launch, prior: LaunchResult, prompt: str) -> Launch | None
    signals: Signals = claude_wire.SIGNALS
    stop_hooks_file: str | None = 'hooks/hooks.json'
    @classmethod
    def tool_deny_problem(cls, denied: tuple[str, ...]) -> str | None
    watched_limits: frozenset[str] = frozenset({'context_budget'})
    wire: ModuleType | None = claude_wire

class EventFold
    def __init__(self) -> None
    def add_call(self, call: CallUsage, cost: float | None = None) -> None
    agent: str = ''
    calls: list[CallUsage]
    context_window: int | None
    cost: float | None
    def ending(self, *, exit_code: int | None, killed: Stop | None) -> Ending
    def feed(self, ev: dict[str, Any]) -> Stop | None
    def feed_line(self, raw: bytes | str) -> Stop | None
    known_events: frozenset[str] | None = None
    def launch_result(
        self,
        launch: Launch,
        agent: str,
        stop: Stop,
        *,
        exit_code: int | None,
        **fields: Any,
    ) -> LaunchResult
    def note_tool(self, name: str, args: object = None) -> None
    def note_web_query(self, query: object) -> None
    def read(self, data: bytes) -> Self
    def result(
        self,
        launch: Launch,
        agent: str,
        *,
        exit_code: int | None,
        killed: Stop | None,
    ) -> LaunchResult
    saw_any
    session_id
    signals: Signals = Signals()
    def stop(self, *, exit_code: int | None, killed: Stop | None) -> Stop
    tool_args: dict[str, list[str]]
    tool_uses: Counter[str]
    def unknown(self, typ: str) -> bool
    unread: Counter[str]
    def usage(self) -> Usage
    def warn_unread(self) -> None
    web_queries: list[str]

@dataclass
class LaunchResult
    def __init__(
        self,
        label: str,
        agent: str = '',
        stop: Stop = Stop.LAUNCH_FAILED,
        ok: bool = False,
        started_at: str = '',
        wall_s: float = 0.0,
        exit_code: int | None = None,
        cli_version: str = '',
        argv: list[str] = list(),
        model: str = '',
        credential: str = 'ambient',
        api_key_source: str = '',
        session_id: str = '',
        num_turns: int | None = None,
        duration_api_ms: int | None = None,
        result_text: str = '',
        structured_output: dict[str, Any] | list[Any] | None = None,
        cost_usd: float | None = None,
        usage: Usage = Usage(),
        other_models: dict[str, OtherModel] = dict(),
        quota: list[QuotaReading] = list(),
        quota_refusal: QuotaRefusal | None = None,
        permission_denials: list[dict[str, Any]] = list(),
        tool_uses: dict[str, int] = dict(),
        web_queries: list[str] = list(),
        hollow: bool = False,
        safety_stops: list[SafetyStop] = list(),
        unread_events: dict[str, int] = dict(),
        init_model: str = '',
        init_tools: int = 0,
        init_errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = list(),
        api_retries: int = 0,
        retry_errors: dict[str, int] = dict(),
        stderr_tail: str = '',
        raw_result: dict[str, Any] = dict(),
        rounds: int | None = None,
        round_errors: list[list[str]] = list(),
        round_costs: list[float | None] = list(),
        unwrapped: bool = False,
        hook_errors: list[list[str]] = list(),
        context_budget: int | None = None,
        context_warned: bool = False,
        context_window: int | None = None,
        retryable: bool = True,
    ) -> None
    agent: str = ''
    api_key_source: str = ''
    api_retries: int = 0
    argv: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]
    cli_version: str = ''
    context_budget: int | None = None
    @property context_pct: float | None
    context_warned: bool = False
    context_window: int | None = None
    cost_usd: float | None = None
    credential: str = 'ambient'
    duration_api_ms: int | None = None
    exit_code: int | None = None
    hollow: bool = False
    hook_errors: list[list[str]] = field(default_factory=list)
    init_errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    init_model: str = ''
    init_tools: int = 0
    label: str
    model: str = ''
    num_turns: int | None = None
    ok: bool = False
    other_models: dict[str, OtherModel] = field(default_factory=dict)
    @property peak_context: int | None
    permission_denials: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    quota: list[QuotaReading] = field(default_factory=list)
    quota_refusal: QuotaRefusal | None = None
    raw_result: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    def record(self, path: Path) -> None
    result_text: str = ''
    retry_errors: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    retryable: bool = True
    round_costs: list[float | None] = field(default_factory=list)
    round_errors: list[list[str]] = field(default_factory=list)
    rounds: int | None = None
    safety_stops: list[SafetyStop] = field(default_factory=list)
    session_id: str = ''
    started_at: str = ''
    stderr_tail: str = ''
    stop: Stop = Stop.LAUNCH_FAILED
    structured_output: dict[str, Any] | list[Any] | None = None
    tool_uses: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    unread_events: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    unwrapped: bool = False
    usage: Usage = field(default_factory=Usage)
    wall_s: float = 0.0
    web_queries: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

class Sink(Protocol)
    def __call__(self, line: bytes, /) -> Stop | None

class Stop(str, enum.Enum)
    ABORTED = 'aborted'
    API_ERROR = 'api_error'
    AUTH_FAILED = 'auth_failed'
    BUDGET = 'budget'
    COMPLETED = 'completed'
    CONTEXT = 'context_budget'
    CREDENTIAL_MISMATCH = 'credential_mismatch'
    DENIED = 'denied'
    ERROR = 'error'
    INVALID_INPUT = 'invalid_input'
    INVALID_OUTPUT = 'invalid_output'
    LAUNCH_FAILED = 'launch_failed'
    MAX_TURNS = 'max_turns'
    NO_OUTPUT = 'no_output'
    RATE_LIMITED = 'rate_limited'
    REFUSED = 'refused'
    STALLED = 'stalled'
    TIMEOUT = 'timeout'

    @property context_total: int
    output_total: int = 0
    @property peak_context: int
    @property resident: int
    def totals(self, context_window: int | None = None) -> TokenUsage | None

    )

    ) -> Launch

    model_failover

    rests

    run_id

@dataclass(eq=False)
class FlowCall

        self,
        id: str,

        function: str = '',

        frontier: tuple[str, ...] = (),

        error: BaseException | None = None,
        time_box: TimeBox | None = None,
        started_at: float = time.time(),
        _children: itertools.count = (lambda: itertools.count(1))(),
    ) -> None
    error: BaseException | None = None
    frontier: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    function: str = ''
    gen: Generator[Any, Any, Any] = field(repr=False)
    id: str
    parent: FlowCall | None = field(default=None, repr=False)
    site: tuple[str, int] | None = None
    started_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    state: FlowState = 'running'
    time_box: TimeBox | None = None
    value: Any = field(default=None, repr=False)

    slow_step_s
    def start(self, flow: Generator[Any, Any, Any]) -> list[Task]
    def time_boxes(self, call: FlowCall | None) -> tuple[TimeBox, ...]
    @property waiting: list[FlowCall]

    rule

    account: str = ''

    until: str = ''
    window: Literal['', Window] = ''

        self,

    )

class Router
    def __init__(
        self,
        primary: Route,
        fallbacks: tuple[Route, ...] = (),
        probe_interval_s: float = 900.0,
        max_probe_interval_s: float = 7200.0,
        clock: Callable[[], float] = time.monotonic,
    ) -> None
    def active(self) -> Route | None
    def chain(self) -> str
    def describe(self) -> str
    @property exhausted: bool
    def history(self) -> list[tuple[str, str]]
    def hop_of(self, route: Route) -> int
    def label_of(self, route: Route) -> str
    max_probe_interval_s
    def next_route_after(self, route: Route) -> Route | None
    def now(self) -> float
    def on_credential(self, credential: str) -> Router
    def other_agents_after(self, route: Route) -> list[Route]
    def pick(self) -> Route | None
    primary
    probe_interval_s
    def rate_limited(self, route: Route | None, retry_after_s: float | None = None) -> str
    routes: tuple[Route, ...]
    def same_agent_after(self, route: Route) -> list[Route]
    def succeeded(self, route: Route | None, started: float | None = None) -> None

@dataclass
class RoutingPlan
    def __init__(
        self,
        config: PipelineConfig,
        backends: Mapping[str, Backend],
        configs: dict[str, KindConfig] = dict(),
        routers: dict[str, Router] = dict(),
        overrides: Overrides = Overrides(),
        credentials: dict[str, Credential] = dict(),
    ) -> None
    backends: Mapping[str, Backend]
    @classmethod
    def build(
        cls,
        config: PipelineConfig,
        kinds: Iterable[Any],
        backends: Mapping[str, Backend],
        overrides: Overrides = Overrides(),
        *,
        declared: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None,
        bases: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
        requirements: Mapping[str, Iterable[str]] | None = None,
        light: Iterable[str] = (),
        budgets_required: bool = True,
        all_kinds: bool = True,
    ) -> RoutingPlan
    def call_problems(self, kind: str, credential: str) -> list[str]
    config: PipelineConfig
    configs: dict[str, KindConfig] = field(default_factory=dict)
    credentials: dict[str, Credential] = field(default_factory=dict)
    def log(self) -> None
    overrides: Overrides = Overrides()
    def preflight(self, policy: PreflightPolicy) -> PreflightRecord
    routers: dict[str, Router] = field(default_factory=dict)
    def routes(self) -> dict[str, str]

class Run
    def __init__(
        self,
        run_id: str,
        runs_dir: str | Path = 'runs',
        *,
        run_group: str = '',
        lock: bool = True,
        fresh: bool = False,
        row_extras: Callable[[TaskResult], dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
        unit_of: Callable[[Task], str] | None = None,
        log: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
        cwd: str | Path | None = None,
        config: PipelineConfig | None = None,
    )
    def agent_runner(
        self,
        backends: Backend | Mapping[str, Backend],
        configs: Mapping[str, KindConfig],
        *,
        adapter: TaskAdapter | None = None,
        routers: Mapping[str, Router] | None = None,
        model: str = '',
        model_failover: bool = False,
        credentials: Mapping[str, Credential] | None = None,
        env: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
        keep_transcripts: bool = False,
        cwd: Path | str | None = None,
        scopes: Sequence[TaskScope] = (),
        enrichers: Sequence[ResultEnricher] = (),
        rests: QuotaRests | None = None,
    ) -> AgentRunner
    def close(self) -> None
    config
    def cursor(
        self,
        *,
        stages: Iterable[object] | None = None,
        steps: Iterable[object] | None = None,
        skip_when_completed: Iterable[object] = (),
    ) -> CursorStore
    dir: Path
    def estimator(self) -> JournalEstimates
    def finish(self) -> None
    def install_signal_handlers(self) -> None
    journal: Journal
    def on_teardown(self, callback: Callable[[], None]) -> None
    def progress(self, line: str, *, warning: bool = False) -> None
    def python_runner(
        self,
        inner: TaskRunner | None = None,
        adapter: TaskAdapter | None = None,
        cwd: str | Path | None = None,
        *,
        scopes: Sequence[TaskScope] = (),
        enrichers: Sequence[ResultEnricher] = (),
    ) -> PythonTaskRunner
    def queue(
        self,
        runner: TaskRunner,
        *,
        follow_up: FollowUp | None = None,
        resume: bool = False,
        max_concurrent: int = MAX_CONCURRENT,
        deadline_s: float | None = None,
        retry_wait_s: float = RETRY_WAIT_S,
        throttle_s: float = THROTTLE_S,
        skip: Callable[[Task], bool] | None = None,
        grace_s: float = GRACE_S,
        retry_on: frozenset[str] = RETRY_ON,
        throttle_on: frozenset[str] = THROTTLE_ON,
        finishing_kinds: Iterable[str] = (),
        claim_capacity: Mapping[str, int | PerTask] | None = None,
        estimate: Callable[[Task], float | None] | None = None,
        overdue_s: float = OVERDUE_S,
        slack_s: float | None = None,
    ) -> WorkQueue
    def quota_rests(
        self,
        credentials: Mapping[str, Credential],
        rule: QuotaRule | None = None,
        *,
        finishing_kinds: Iterable[str] = (),
        grace_s: float = GRACE_S,
    ) -> QuotaRests
    def record_attempt(self, result: TaskResult) -> None
    def record_flow_call(
        self,
        event: str,
        call_id: str,
        *,
        parent: str | None = None,
        function: str = '',
        flow: Sequence[Frame] = (),
        state: FlowState | None = None,
        error: BaseException | None = None,
        time_box: TimeBox | None = None,
        started_at: float | None = None,
    ) -> None
    def rows(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]
    run_group: str
    run_id: str
    def run_python_steps(self, steps: list[tuple[str, Callable[[], None]]]) -> None
    runs_dir: Path
    def stop_on_signals(self) -> None
    def teardown(self) -> None
    def update_info(self, **fields: Any) -> None

class RunnerConfig(Protocol)
    @property max_concurrent: int | None

class TaskAdapter
    def changes(self, task: Task) -> Sequence[str]
    def context_files(self, task: Task, backend: Backend) -> tuple[str, ...]
    def definition(self, task: Task) -> dict[str, Any] | None
    def env(self, task: Task) -> dict[str, str]
    def input_contracts(self, task: Task) -> Sequence[InputContract]
    def mcp_config_path(self, task: Task) -> str | None
    def missing_params(self, task: Task) -> list[str]
    def output_contracts(self, task: Task) -> Sequence[OutputContract]
    def plugin_dirs(self, task: Task) -> tuple[str, ...]
    def prompt(self, task: Task, backend: Backend) -> str
    def role(self, task: Task) -> str | None
    def settings_path(self, task: Task) -> str | None
    def system_prompt(self, task: Task) -> str | None
    def tools(self, task: Task) -> tuple[str, ...] | None

class TaskRunner(Protocol)
    def config(self, task: Task) -> RunnerConfig
    def run(self, task: Task) -> TaskResult

class UnitCursor(BaseModel)
    completed: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    history: list[HistoryEntry] = Field(default_factory=list)
    inflight: Inflight | None = None
    loop_pass: int = 0
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid', validate_assignment=True)
    stage: str | None = None
    step: str | None = None

class WaitsFor(Protocol)
    def __call__(self, item: Any, /) -> Task

class WorkQueue
    def __init__(
        self,
        runner: TaskRunner,
        *,
        follow_up: FollowUp | None = None,
        on_event: OnEvent | None = None,
        on_result: OnResult | None = None,
        max_concurrent: int = MAX_CONCURRENT,
        deadline_s: float | None = None,
        retry_wait_s: float = RETRY_WAIT_S,
        throttle_s: float = THROTTLE_S,
        skip: Callable[[Task], bool] | None = None,
        grace_s: float = GRACE_S,
        retry_on: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
        throttle_on: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
        finishing_kinds: tuple[str, ...] = (),
        claim_capacity: Mapping[str, int | ClaimCapacity] | None = None,
        estimate: Callable[[Task], float | None] | None = None,
        overdue_s: float = OVERDUE_S,
        slack_s: float | None = None,
    )
    def add(self, task: Task) -> bool
    def capacity(self, name: str) -> int
    claim_capacity: dict[str, int | ClaimCapacity]
    deadline_at: float | None
    deferred: list[Task]
    def extend(self, tasks: Iterable[Task]) -> None
    finishing_kinds: tuple[str, ...]
    follow_up: FollowUp
    grace_s
    hard_stop_at: float | None
    def in_endgame(self) -> bool
    max_concurrent: int
    on_event: OnEvent
    overdue_s
    def past_deadline(self) -> bool
    def past_hard_stop(self) -> bool
    results: list[TaskResult]
    retry_on: frozenset[str]
    retry_wait_s
    def run(self) -> dict[str, Any]
    runner
    slack_s: float
    def slots(self) -> int
    throttle_on: frozenset[str]
    throttle_s
    time_box: TimeBox | None

def run_until_valid(
    backend: Backend,
    launch: Launch,
    contracts: Sequence[OutputContract],
    max_corrections: int = DEFAULT_MAX_CORRECTIONS,
) -> LaunchResult

        self,

        agents: tuple[str, ...] = (),
    ) -> None

    def besides_skills(self) -> list[str]
    def definition(self, role: str | None, limit: int = 40000) -> dict[str, Any]
    hooks: tuple[dict[str, Any], ...] = ()
    def lint(self) -> list[str]
    @classmethod
    def load(cls, root: str | Path) -> Plugin
    name: str
    def render_leftovers(self) -> list[str]
    def resolve_role(self, role: str | None) -> str | None
    def role_file(self, role: str) -> Path
    @property roles: tuple[str, ...]
    root: Path
    def skill_files(self) -> list[tuple[str, str]]
    @property skills_only: bool

def new_plugin(directory: str | Path, name: str = '') -> list[Path]

@dataclass
class Panel
    def __init__(
        self,
        fn: PanelFn | TrendsPanelFn,
        title: str = '',
        description: str = '',
        icon: str = '▤',
        scope: Literal['run', 'trends'] = 'run',
        tab: str = '',
    ) -> None

    fn: PanelFn | TrendsPanelFn

    def info(self, name: str) -> dict[str, Any]
    scope: Literal['run', 'trends'] = 'run'
    tab: str = ''
    title: str = ''

PanelBody = Annotated[Annotated[TilesBody, Tag('tiles')] | Annotated[TableBody, Tag('table')] | Annotated[ColumnsBody, Tag('columns')] | Annotated[LinesBody, Tag('lines')] | Annotated[HeatmapBody, Tag('heatmap')] | Annotated[HBarsBody, Tag('hbars')] | Annotated[StatusGridBody, Tag('status_grid')] | Annotated[NoteBody, Tag('note')] | Annotated[CodeBody, Tag('code')] | Annotated[TreeBody, Tag('tree')] | Annotated[BlocksBody, Tag('blocks')] | Annotated[dict[str, Any], Tag('untyped')], Discriminator(_panel_kind)]

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Period
    def __init__(self, start: date, end: date, tz: str = 'UTC') -> None
    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]
    @property closes: datetime
    def day_of(self, ts: object) -> date | None
    @property days: list[date]
    end: date
    @property opens: datetime
    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, start: str = '', end: str = '', tz: str = '', *, today: date | None = None) -> Period
    start: date
    tz: str = 'UTC'
    @property zone: ZoneInfo

class PeriodError(ValueError)

class RunSource(Protocol)
    def activity(self, run: str) -> str | None
    def dir(self, run: str) -> Path | None
    def document(self, run: str, name: str) -> str | None
    def documents(self, run: str) -> list[str]
    def exists(self, run: str, name: str) -> bool
    def file(self, run: str, path: str) -> RunFile | None
    def file_stat(self, run: str, path: str) -> Stat | None
    def folder(self, run: str, folder: str) -> list[str]
    def info(self, run: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None
    def keep(self, run: str, text: str) -> None
    def kept(self, run: str) -> str | None
    def lines(
        self,
        run: str,
        log: str,
        since: int = 0,
        limit: int | None = None,
        max_bytes: int | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[list[str], int]
    def lines_at(
        self,
        run: str,
        log: str,
        at: LogPosition,
        limit: int | None = None,
        max_bytes: int | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[list[str], LogPosition]
    def logs(self, run: str) -> list[str]
    def position(self, run: str, log: str, line: int) -> LogPosition
    def runs(self) -> list[str]
    def size(self, run: str, log: str) -> int
    def stat(self, run: str, name: str = '') -> Stat | None
    async def wait(self, run: str, log: str, beyond: int, timeout: float) -> int

    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    tiles: list[PanelTile]
    title: str | None = Field(default=None, description='a heading over the body')
    type: Literal['tiles'] = 'tiles'

class TreeBody(_Body)
    anchor: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, description="a name a tree node's link leads to: the body is scrolled into view (`TreeLink.anchor`)")
    collapsed: bool = Field(default=False, description='shown folded, under its title')
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    nodes: list[TreeNode]
    selected: str | None = None
    title: str | None = Field(default=None, description='a heading over the body')
    type: Literal['tree'] = 'tree'

class TreeLink(Closed)
    anchor: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    panel: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    run: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, description='the run of `panel` or `task`; a trends panel names it')
    task: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, description="a task's key")

class TreeNode(Closed)
    badge: str | None = None
    children: list[TreeNode] = Field(default_factory=list)
    code: CodeBody | None = None
    icon: Literal['file', 'directory'] | None = None
    id: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    link: TreeLink | None = None
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    name: str = Field(min_length=1)
    open: bool = True
    tone: Tone | None = None

class TrendsPanelFn(Protocol)
    def __call__(self, runs: PeriodRuns, period: Period, /) -> PanelBody | BaseModel | Mapping[str, Any]

def create_app(
    monitor: Monitor,
    *,
    allowed_hosts: Iterable[str] = (),
    cors_origins: Iterable[str] = (),
    docs: bool = False,
    base_path: str = '',
) -> FastAPI

def export(
    monitor: Monitor,
    out: str | Path,
    *,
    runs: int | None = 10,
    since: str | None = None,
    keep: Iterable[str] = (),
    exclude: Iterable[str] = (),
    period: Period | None = None,
    live: bool = False,
    now: Callable[[], datetime] = lambda: datetime.now(UTC),
) -> ExportReport

def serve(
    monitor: Monitor,
    host: str = '127.0.0.1',
    port: int = 8787,
    *,
    allowed_hosts: Iterable[str] = (),
    cors_origins: Iterable[str] = (),
    docs: bool = False,
    base_path: str = '',
) -> None

class AccountQuota(Closed)

AnyTranscriptEvent = Annotated[Annotated[LaunchEvent, Tag('LaunchEvent')] | Annotated[MessageUpdateEvent, Tag('MessageUpdateEvent')] | Annotated[ToolStartEvent, Tag('ToolStartEvent')] | Annotated[ToolEndEvent, Tag('ToolEndEvent')] | Annotated[ToolCallEchoEvent, Tag('ToolCallEchoEvent')] | Annotated[ToolResultEchoEvent, Tag('ToolResultEchoEvent')] | Annotated[MessageEvent, Tag('MessageEvent')] | Annotated[NoticeEvent, Tag('NoticeEvent')] | Annotated[RetryEvent, Tag('RetryEvent')] | Annotated[OtherEvent, Tag('other')], Discriminator(_event_tag), WrapValidator(_lenient)]

class PlanNode(PlanRow)
    after: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description='task keys it waits for')
    attempts: int = 1
    base_kind: str = Field('', description="an implementation kind's base kind (`agent_task(implementations=)`), its group unless `groups` lists it; else empty")
    claims: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="the names it holds while it runs, its kind's `claims` filled in")
    created_from: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description='keys whose results its flow call had received when it created it')
    credential: str = Field('', description='the credential its task call names (`credential=`), which every route of its kind ran it as; empty when it names none, or a run-wide override outranks it')
    deferred: str = Field('', description='why the queue deferred it, never launched (`deferred.jsonl`): a deadline, a resting credential; empty when it was not')
    deferred_cause: DeferralCause | None = Field(None, description='the same as data; null when it was not deferred, or the run recorded no cause')
    executor: Executor = 'agent'
    flow: list[Frame] = Field(default_factory=list, description='the flow path: frames of flow code that created it, outermost first')
    flow_call: str | None = Field(None, description='the id of the flow call that created it; null for a task with no origin')
    group: str
    key: str
    kind: str
    level: int = Field(description='depth in the dependency graph, 0 for a task that waits for nothing')
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='allow', serialize_by_alias=True)
    priority: float = Field(0.0, description="its task call's `priority`: a tie-breaker in the queue, higher first")
    rerun: str = Field('', description='why a resume ran it again although an earlier attempt of the run had finished it (its outside state changed, ...), from its last journal row; empty when no earlier attempt had')
    route: str = ''
    state: TaskState
    stop: str = ''
    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]
    ts: str = Field('', description='when it was queued (absent for a node rebuilt from the journal)')
    unit: str = ''
    wall_s: float = 0.0

RunEvent = JournalMessage | ProcsMessage | PlanMessage | OutputsMessage | CursorMessage | PanelMessage | ReadyMessage

class RunSummary(Closed)
    attempts: int = Field(description='journal rows: finished task attempts')
    cost_usd: float | None = Field(None, description='what the coding agents reported the run cost, in USD; null when none reported')
    host_id: str = Field('', description='the host that drives it; empty when its run.json does not say')
    kinds: dict[str, int] = Field(description='journal rows per task kind')
    last_ts: str = Field(description="ISO time of the last journal row, else the directory's mtime")
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    not_run: int = Field(0, description='journal rows of tasks that never ran: refused for an input (`invalid_input`) or skipped')
    ok: int = Field(description='journal rows that passed, not counting `partial` ones')
    partial: int = Field(0, description='journal rows with stop `partial`')
    quota: list[AccountQuota] = Field(default_factory=list, description="per credential (account): the run's first and last utilization reading; highest weekly use first")
    replay: str = Field('', description="a replay: the directory of the recordings it played (`Pipeline(replay=)`), and with `record_missing` recorded into (then `stub` is false, and each played attempt's journal row says `replayed`); empty otherwise")
    row_extras: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="the journal columns that are the pipeline's own (`Run(row_extras=)`), in the order they first appear")
    run: str
    run_group: str = Field(description='the label grouping runs (`Run(run_group=)`); the run id when none was given')
    run_uid: str = Field('', description='the id no other run has, on any host; empty when its run.json does not say')
    running: bool = Field(description='the process that runs it is alive')
    started_at: str
    stub: bool = Field(False, description="a stub run: the stub agent, or a replay's recordings, played its tasks (`Pipeline(stub=)`, `contraagent run --stub`)")
    tasks: TaskCounts
    tokens: TokenUsage = Field(description='tokens of every attempt, summed')
    unresponsive: bool = Field(False, description='its host last reported it alive and has stopped reporting (a hub only)')
    wall_s: int = Field(description="sum of the rows' wall time, rounded to seconds")

class ServiceSpan(Closed)
    address: str | None = Field(None, description='what it gave its tasks to reach it; null for none')
    key: str = Field('', description='the task whose claim started it')
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    name: str = Field(description='the claim name the service stands for')
    start_error: str = Field('', description='the exception of a start that failed (the service did not start); empty when it started')
    start_s: float = Field(0.0, description='how long its start took, in seconds')
    started_at: str = Field(description='when its start ended, ISO 8601')
    stop_cause: ServiceStopCause | None = Field(None, description='why it stopped; null while it is up')
    stop_error: str = Field('', description='the exception its stop raised; empty when the stop went well')
    stopped_at: str = Field('', description='when it stopped, ISO 8601; empty while it is up, or when the run ended with no stop recorded')

class TaskDefinition(Open)
    base_kind: str | None = Field(None, description="agent task: an implementation kind's base kind (`agent_task(implementations=)`)")
    doc: str | None = Field(None, description="Python task: the function's docstring")
    executor: Executor | None = None
    file: str | None = Field(None, description="Python task: the source file, relative to the run's working directory when inside it")
    files: list[DefinitionFile] = Field(default_factory=list)
    function: str | None = Field(None, description='Python task: `module.qualname` of its function')
    kind: str
    line: int | None = Field(None, description="Python task: the function's first line in `file`")
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
    name: str | None = None
    output: str | None = None
    output_from: Literal['file', 'message'] | None = Field(None, description='agent task: `file`, the agent writes its output; `message`, its final message is the output')
    output_of: str | None = Field(None, description='agent task: the kind whose output file it writes (`agent_task(output_of=)`)')
    params: str | None = None
    plugin: bool | None = None
    plugin_dirs: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    preserve: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description='agent task: JSON pointers to the parts of its output file it keeps (`agent_task(preserve=)`)')
    requires: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    retries: int | None = Field(None, description='Python task: the fresh attempts after the first, each after an exception of `retry_on` (`@python_task(retries=)`)')
    retry_on: list[str] | None = Field(None, description='Python task: the exception classes that give an attempt a fresh one')
    role: str | None = None
    root: str | None = None
    signature: str | None = Field(None, description="Python task: the function's signature")
    tools: list[str] | None = Field(None, description='agent task: `[]`, a light launch with no tools (`agent_task(tools=())`); null, the tools its role allows')
    validators: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

class TaskDetail(Open)
    definition: TaskDefinition | None
    io: TaskIO
    key: str = Field(description='the task key asked for')
    launches: list[TaskLaunch] = Field(description='its launches running now; empty once it has finished (finished attempts are `rows`)')
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
    row_extras: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="the columns of `rows` that are the pipeline's own (`Run(row_extras=)`), in the order they first appear")
    rows: list[JournalRow]
    stream: str | None = Field(description="the transcript's task key for /stream and /events/stream, null when it has none")
    task_detail_error: str | None = None

class TaskIO(Closed)
    downstream: list[DownstreamTask]
    executor: Executor
    inputs: list[ContractSpec]
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    outputs: list[ContractSpec]
    params: dict[str, Any]
    upstream: list[UpstreamTask]

class TaskLaunch(Closed)
    age_s: int | None
    cmd: str = Field(description='the full command line, cut at 600 characters')
    key: str | None
    kind: str | None
    model: str | None
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    pid: int | None
    plugin: str | None
    role: str | None
    unit: str | None

class TimeBoxRecord(BaseModel)
    deadline_s: float = Field(description='seconds from `started_at` to the deadline')
    finishing_kinds: tuple[str, ...] = Field(default=(), description='the kinds that still launch past the deadline')
    grace_s: float = Field(description='seconds past the deadline its `finishing_kinds` still launch')
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid', frozen=True)
    slack_s: float = Field(description='seconds before the deadline from which its tasks are ordered for it')
    started_at: str = Field(description='when the flow call started, where its deadline counts from (UTC ISO 8601)')

class ToolCallEchoEvent(TranscriptEvent)
    call: str
    cmd: str
    intent: str
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
    tool: str | None
    type: Literal['acall']
    web_fetch: str | None = Field(None, description='the URL, when the call reads a web page')
    web_query: str | None = Field(None, description='the query, when the call is a web search')

class ToolEndEvent(TranscriptEvent)
    call: str
    err: bool
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
    out: str
    tool: str | None
    type: Literal['tool_execution_end']

class ToolResultEchoEvent(TranscriptEvent)
    call: str
    err: bool
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
    out: str
    tool: str | None
    type: Literal['aresult']

class ToolStartEvent(TranscriptEvent)
    call: str
    cmd: str = Field(description='a one-line preview: the command, pattern, path, URL or query')
    intent: str
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
    tool: str | None
    type: Literal['tool_execution_start', 'tool_execution_update']
    web_fetch: str | None = Field(None, description='the URL, when the call reads a web page')
    web_query: str | None = Field(None, description='the query, when the call is a web search')

class TrendDay(Closed)
    attempts: int
    cost_usd: dict[str, float] = Field(description='group -> cost, USD; a group with no cost reported is absent')
    day: str
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    ok: int = Field(description='attempts that passed, not counting `partial` ones')
    partial: int = Field(0, description='attempts with stop `partial`: ok, counted apart from `ok`')

class TrendDeferral(Closed)
    cause: str
    key: str
    kind: str
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    reason: str
    run: str
    ts: str

class TrendDenial(Closed)
    count: int
    kinds: dict[str, int]
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    tool: str

class TrendKind(Closed)
    attempts: int
    cost_usd: float | None
    executor: Executor
    group: str
    kind: str
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    ok: int = Field(description='attempts that passed, not counting `partial` ones')
    partial: int = Field(0, description='attempts with stop `partial`: ok, counted apart from `ok`')
    tasks: int
    tasks_ok: int = Field(description='tasks whose last attempt passed, not counting `partial` ones')
    tasks_partial: int = Field(0, description='tasks whose last attempt was `partial`')
    tokens: TokenUsage
    wall_s: float = Field(description="every attempt's wall time, summed")
    wall_s_median: float = Field(description="the median attempt's wall time")

class TrendPeriod(Closed)
    days: list[str] = Field(description='every day of the period, in order')
    from_: str = Field(alias='from', description='the first day, YYYY-MM-DD')
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid', populate_by_name=True)
    to: str = Field(description='the last day, YYYY-MM-DD')
    tz: str

class TrendQuota(Closed)
    account: str = Field('', description='the account the readings are of (`QuotaReading.account`); empty when not known')
    credential: str
    daily_peak: list[float | None] = Field(description='per day of `period.days`; null when no reading arrived that day')
    hourly_peak: list[float | None] = Field(description="per hour from the period's first instant (the first day's midnight in `tz`); null when no reading arrived in it")
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    window: str = Field(description='`five_hour`, `seven_day`, or another window a reading names (`seven_day_opus`)')

class TrendRest(RestEvent)
    event: Literal['start', 'end']
    run: str
    ts: str

class TrendRun(Closed)
    attempts: int
    cost_usd: float | None
    finished_at: str
    host_id: str
    last_ts: str = Field(description='when its last attempt in the period ended; empty when it has none')
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    ok: int = Field(description='attempts that passed, not counting `partial` ones')
    partial: int = Field(0, description='attempts with stop `partial`: ok, counted apart from `ok`')
    run: str
    run_group: str
    started_at: str
    stub: bool
    wall_s: float

class TrendSafetyStop(Closed)
    count: int
    kinds: dict[str, int]
    model: str = Field(description='the model whose safeguards stopped it, as the coding agent names it; empty when not said')
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    part: SafetyStopPart

class TrendStarts(Closed)
    counts: list[list[int]]
    hours: list[int]
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    weekdays: list[str]

class TrendStop(Closed)
    attempts: int
    kinds: dict[str, int]
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    stop: str

class TrendTotals(Closed)
    attempts: int
    cost_usd: float | None = Field(description='what the coding agents reported; null when no attempt reported a cost')
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    ok: int = Field(description='attempts that passed, not counting `partial` ones')
    partial: int = Field(0, description='attempts with stop `partial`: ok, counted apart from `ok`')
    runs: int = Field(description='runs with an attempt in the period, or started in it')
    tokens: TokenUsage
    wall_s: float

class Trends(Closed)
    bodies: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]
    daily: list[TrendDay]
    deferred: list[TrendDeferral]
    deferred_causes: dict[str, int]
    denials: list[TrendDenial]
    kinds: list[TrendKind]
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    models: list[ModelUsage]
    panels: list[PanelInfo]
    period: TrendPeriod
    quota: list[TrendQuota]
    rests: list[TrendRest]
    runs: list[TrendRun]
    safety_stops: list[TrendSafetyStop]
    starts: TrendStarts
    stops: list[TrendStop]
    totals: TrendTotals

class UnitPosition(Closed)
    completed: list[str]
    inflight: list[str]
    loop_pass: int
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    stage: str | None
    step: str | None

class UpstreamTask(Closed)
    executor: Executor
    key: str
    kind: str
    model_config: ConfigDict = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
    outputs: list[ContractSpec]
    unit: str

## contraagent.testing

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Reply
    def __init__(
        self,
        output: Any = _UNSET,
        stop: Stop = Stop.COMPLETED,
        reason: str = '',
        quota: QuotaReading | None = None,
        quota_refusal: QuotaRefusal | None = None,
        cost_usd: float | None = None,
        peak_context: int | None = None,
        context_window: int | None = None,
        safety_stops: tuple[SafetyStop, ...] = (),
    ) -> None
    context_window: int | None = None
    cost_usd: float | None = None
    output: Any = _UNSET
    peak_context: int | None = None
    quota: QuotaReading | None = None
    quota_refusal: QuotaRefusal | None = None
    reason: str = ''
    safety_stops: tuple[SafetyStop, ...] = ()
    stop: Stop = Stop.COMPLETED

class StubAgent(Backend)
    def __init__(
        self,
        script: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        *,
        default: Any = _UNSET,
        execute: Iterable[str] = (),
        delay_s: float = 0.0,
    ) -> None
    def argv(self, launch: Launch) -> list[str]
    def backends(self, names: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, StubAgent]
    binary = ''
    def bind_credential(
        self,
        credential: Credential,
        model: str = '',
        *,
        env: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        label: str = '',
    ) -> CredentialBinding
    default
    delay_s
    def env(self, launch: Launch) -> dict[str, str]
    execute: frozenset[str]
    launches: list[StubLaunch]
    def launches_of(self, key: str, run: str | None = None) -> list[StubLaunch]
    light_launch = True
    name = 'stub'
    def play_python(
        self,
        run: str,
        key: str,
        kind: str,
        unit: str,
        params: dict[str, Any],
        json_schema: dict[str, Any] | None,
        *,
        rows: bool = False,
    ) -> tuple[bool, Any]
    played: list[StubTask]
    def plays(self, kind: str) -> bool
    def resumable(self, launch: Launch) -> Launch
    def resumed(self, launch: Launch, prior: LaunchResult, prompt: str) -> Launch | None
    def run(self, launch: Launch) -> LaunchResult
    script: dict[str, Any]
    @classmethod
    def tool_deny_problem(cls, denied: tuple[str, ...]) -> str | None

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StubLaunch
    def __init__(
        self,
        run: str,
        key: str,
        kind: str,
        unit: str,
        params: dict[str, Any],
        model: str,
        role: str | None,
        n: int,
        resumed: bool,
        prompt: str,
        call: CallFile,
        launch: Launch,
        in_turn: bool = False,
    ) -> None
    call: CallFile = field(repr=False)
    in_turn: bool = False
    key: str
    kind: str
    launch: Launch = field(repr=False)
    model: str
    n: int
    params: dict[str, Any]
    prompt: str
    resumed: bool
    role: str | None
    run: str
    unit: str

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StubTask
    def __init__(self, run: str, key: str, kind: str, unit: str, params: dict[str, Any], n: int) -> None
    key: str
    kind: str
    n: int
    params: dict[str, Any] = field(repr=False)
    run: str
    unit: str

def fails(stop: Stop = Stop.ERROR, reason: str = 'stub: scripted failure') -> Reply

def rate_limited(retry_after_s: float | None = None) -> Reply

def writes(
    value: Any,
    *,
    stop: Stop = Stop.COMPLETED,
    cost_usd: float | None = None,
    quota: QuotaReading | None = None,
    peak_context: int | None = None,
    context_window: int | None = None,
    safety_stops: Iterable[SafetyStop] = (),
) -> Reply

def writes_example() -> Reply

def writes_nothing() -> Reply
